response.text: No void invoices and no unposted journals exist. Next I'll check integrity, balance, sign conventions, and the relationships.

arguments.sql:
SELECT 'unbalanced_journals' k, count(*)::text v FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_without_lines', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_without_hdr', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_bad_acct', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" c WHERE c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_dr_or_cr', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<0 OR "CR_AMT"<0
UNION ALL SELECT 'both_dr_cr', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<>0 AND "CR_AMT"<>0
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_vend', count(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_jrnl', count(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_bad_inv', count(*)::text FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnh_bad_prd', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnh_date_outside_prd', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'ref_jrnl_not_null', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_inv_amt', count(*)::text FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_cnt', count(*)::text FROM "APPAYM"
UNION ALL SELECT 'paid_inv_without_pay', count(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='P' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'open_inv_with_pay', count(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='O' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_sum_ne_inv', count(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i JOIN (SELECT "INV_ID", sum("PAY_AMT") s FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY 1) p USING("INV_ID") WHERE p.s<>i."INV_AMT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_inv_no_vend', count(*)::text FROM (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY "VEND_CD","INV_NO" HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnl_shared_by_invoices', count(*)::text FROM (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'closed_prd_close_dt_null', count(*)::text FROM "GLPERD" WHERE "STAT_CD"='C' AND "CLOSE_DT" IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'perd_cnt', count(*)::text FROM "GLPERD"
